privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At ZYRCA, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application and website.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content:
We may collect the following types of information:

• Account Information: Email address, display name, and profile photo when you sign in with Google.
• Health Data: Fasting schedules, water intake, weight measurements, and progress statistics you voluntarily enter.
• Device Information: Device type, operating system version, unique device identifiers, and mobile network information.
• Usage Data: App interactions, feature usage patterns, crash reports, and performance analytics.
• Payment Information: Subscription status and purchase history processed through RevenueCat (we do not store payment card details).

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.content:
We use collected information to:

• Provide and maintain the ZYRCA application and its features
• Deliver fasting guidance, wellness insights, and educational content
• Process subscriptions and in-app purchases via RevenueCat
• Send notifications related to your fasting schedule and health goals
• Analyze app usage to improve features and performance
• Display relevant advertisements through Google AdMob
• Comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Service

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content:
ZYRCA integrates with the following third-party services:

• Firebase (Google): Authentication, cloud storage, analytics, and crash reporting
• Google Sign-In: Account authentication
• RevenueCat: Subscription and purchase management
• Google AdMob: Advertising services
• Google Analytics: Usage analytics and app performance monitoring

Each third-party service has its own privacy policy governing the use of your information. We encourage you to review their policies.

ads.title: Advertising
ads.content: ZYRCA may display advertisements provided by Google AdMob. AdMob may use device identifiers and usage data to serve personalized ads. You can manage ad personalization through your device settings or Google account preferences. Premium subscribers may experience reduced or no advertising.

storage.title: Data Storage and Security
storage.content: Your data is stored securely using Firebase cloud infrastructure with industry-standard encryption. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of electronic storage is 100% secure.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time through the Delete Account page or by contacting nextlevelapps81@gmail.com.

rights.title: Your Rights (GDPR & CCPA)
rights.content:
Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:

• Access: Request a copy of your personal data
• Rectification: Correct inaccurate personal data
• Erasure: Request deletion of your personal data
• Portability: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
• Objection: Object to processing of your personal data
• Restriction: Request restriction of processing

To exercise these rights, contact us at nextlevelapps81@gmail.com. We will respond within 30 days.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.content: ZYRCA is not intended for children under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we discover that a child has provided us with personal information, we will promptly delete it.

international.title: International Data Transfers
international.content: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for such transfers in compliance with applicable data protection laws.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes through the app or via email. Your continued use of ZYRCA after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content:
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

Email: nextlevelapps81@gmail.com
Website: https://zyrca.app

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Please read these Terms of Service carefully before using the ZYRCA application. These Terms also constitute the Terms of Use for the ZYRCA app and related services. By accessing or using ZYRCA, you agree to be bound by these terms.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By downloading, installing, or using ZYRCA, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our {privacyPolicyLink}. If you do not agree, do not use the application.

description.title: Service Description
description.content: ZYRCA is a health and wellness application that provides intermittent fasting tracking, water monitoring, weight management, progress analytics, intelligent fasting guidance, and educational wellness content. ZYRCA is designed to support your wellness journey but is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

account.title: User Accounts
account.content: You may create an account using Google Sign-In. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account. You must provide accurate information and promptly update any changes.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions and Payments
subscriptions.content:
ZYRCA offers premium features through auto-renewable subscriptions.

Purchases are processed by Apple through the App Store on Apple devices and by Google through Google Play on Android devices. RevenueCat helps us manage subscription entitlements and status in the app; it does not process your payments.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless you cancel before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple ID account settings (App Store) or your Google Play account settings.

Billing, cancellations, and refunds are subject to the policies of Apple or Google, as applicable. We do not offer a free trial unless explicitly stated in the store listing at the time of purchase. Subscription prices are displayed in the App Store or Google Play at checkout; we do not list prices here.

Refunds, if available, must be requested through Apple or Google according to their respective refund policies.

conduct.title: User Conduct
conduct.content:
You agree not to:

• Use ZYRCA for any unlawful purpose
• Attempt to reverse engineer or decompile the application
• Interfere with the app's security features
• Share your account credentials with others
• Use automated systems to access the service
• Upload malicious content or attempt to compromise our systems

health.title: Health Disclaimer
health.content: ZYRCA provides general health and wellness information for educational purposes only. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before starting any fasting regimen, especially if you have medical conditions, are pregnant, breastfeeding, or taking medication.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.content: All content, features, and functionality of ZYRCA — including text, graphics, logos, icons, and software — are owned by ZYRCA and protected by international copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without our written permission.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, ZYRCA shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the application. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount you paid for the service in the twelve months preceding the claim.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: We may suspend or terminate your access to ZYRCA at any time for violation of these terms. You may delete your account at any time. Upon termination, your right to use the application ceases immediately, and we will delete your data in accordance with our {privacyPolicyLink}.

governing.title: Governing Law
governing.content: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with applicable laws, without regard to conflict of law principles. Any disputes shall be resolved through good-faith negotiation or, if necessary, binding arbitration.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Material changes will be communicated through the app or email. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For questions about these Terms of Service, contact us at nextlevelapps81@gmail.com.

faqs.question: What is the best intermittent fasting app for beginners?
faqs.answer: ZYRCA is designed for fasting beginners and experienced users. It combines a fasting timer, water tracker, weight tracker, expert guides, and intelligent guidance — so you can start with protocols like 16:8 or 18:6 and track your progress from day one.

faqs.question: How do I start intermittent fasting with ZYRCA?
faqs.answer: Open the app, choose a fasting protocol such as 16:8, 18:6, or OMAD, and tap Start Fast. ZYRCA tracks your fasting window, sends reminders, and saves your complete fasting history.

faqs.question: Does ZYRCA have a fasting timer and water tracker?
faqs.answer: Yes. ZYRCA includes a precise fasting timer, daily water tracker, weight tracker, fasting statistics, achievements, expert guides, and PDF/CSV health report export — all in one wellness app.

faqs.question: How does ZYRCA Intelligence work?
faqs.answer: ZYRCA Intelligence provides wellness insights and helpful answers to common fasting questions. It uses built-in health knowledge and predefined guidance — it is not a dynamic AI chatbot and does not learn from your conversations.

faqs.question: Can I export my fasting and health data?
faqs.answer: Yes. ZYRCA lets you export a PDF health report and CSV data files with your fasting progress, water intake, and weight records.

faqs.question: Is ZYRCA free to use?
faqs.answer: ZYRCA offers a free tier with core fasting and tracking features. Premium subscriptions unlock additional guidance, detailed analytics, report exports, and an ad-free experience.

faqs.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqs.answer: Subscriptions are managed through Google Play or the Apple App Store. Go to your store account settings, find ZYRCA under subscriptions, and select Cancel.

faqs.question: Which languages does ZYRCA support?
faqs.answer: ZYRCA is available in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, and Arabic with full right-to-left support for Arabic.

faqs.question: Is my health data secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your data is encrypted and stored securely. We never sell your personal information. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
